triage.kind_span: issuer tender offer subject to Rule 13e-4.

subject_names.value: Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund
subject_names.span: Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund (Name of Subject Company (Issuer))

subject_tickers.span: The Shares are traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “EVG.”

security_class.span: Common Shares of Beneficial Interest, $.01 par value

price_basis.span: The price to be paid for the Common Shares is an amount per share, net to the seller in cash, equal to 99% of the net asset value per share as of the Expiration Date

price_pct_nav.span: equal to 99% of the net asset value per share as of the Expiration Date

nav_pricing_date.value: close of regular trading of the NYSE on the date the Offer expires
nav_pricing_date.span: Shares will be purchased at 99% of the NAV of the Shares as of the close of regular trading of the NYSE on the date the Offer expires, July 30, 2021

size_pct_outstanding.span: offer to purchase for cash up to 25% or 4,470,149 shares of its outstanding common shares

size_shares.span: up to 25% or 4,470,149 (the “Offer Amount”) of its outstanding

expiration_date.span: The Offer expires on July 30, 2021 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, unless the Fund extends the Offer.

proration.span: If more Shares than the Offer Amount are properly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the Expiration Date, the Fund will, upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Offer, purchase the Offer Amount on a pro rata basis (disregarding fractional shares)
